name: Tarfin
note: Rating note: name and chest sponsor of Fenerbahçe's basketball teams from 2026/27 (the men's team plays as Fenerbahçe Tarfin). Owned by its founders and venture investors (tarfin-ownership); the December 2021 round included Syngenta Group Ventures (Syngenta Group sits under China's state-owned Sinochem), whose stake and any board seat aren't known, so the sponsor stays unrated.
